scope: LimX TRON 1 and TRON 2 single-arm mobile research configurations. Generic TRON is a series/search term; neither base biped is reclassified as a production humanoid. Kit payloads, base specifications and German procurement routes remain separate.

records.name: LimX TRON 1 EDU + Arm Expansion Kit
records.exactConfiguration: TRON 1 EDU research biped with TRON1-AP-YG single-arm expansion kit, gripper and mounting hardware, configured with sole or wheeled feet. Base-only TRON 1 and point-foot locomotion are separate setups.
records.description: Develop arm-and-leg coordination and motion-planning experiments on a compact mobile research platform. It has one added arm; it is not a full-body humanoid or a validated factory worker.

operatingMode.value: Researcher-operated mobile manipulation and developer-controlled policy experiments on the EDU platform.
caveats: No unattended industrial task acceptance is established.
Confirm the control software, foot configuration, recovery procedure and operator supervision for each experiment.

records.name: LimX TRON 2 + Mobile Manipulation Kit
records.exactConfiguration: TRON 2 EDU sole or wheeled-biped base plus the Autonomous Mobile Manipulation Expansion Kit: one 6-DoF arm, standard two-finger gripper, perception and compute package. The reconfigurable tabletop dual-arm setup and base-only 2-in-1 package are different configurations.
records.description: Research floor-level pickup, switch interaction and arm-leg coordination with a mobile single-arm kit. Published kit-specific navigation and sensing data support experiment planning; they do not establish unattended industrial operation.

operatingMode.value: PS4 teleoperation, optional VR integration and researcher-supervised development of manipulation/navigation policies.
caveats: The kit name contains Autonomous, but task-level autonomy and human recovery have not been independently established.
The mobile kit has a single 1.5 kg arm; the separate dual-arm tabletop marketing figures do not apply.
